description: Get a quote for a currency exchange: the rate, the fees, and what the customer receives. Quotes are short-lived, so create one immediately before the transfer. Off-ramp converts a stablecoin to fiat (source network required, destination country required); on-ramp converts fiat to a stablecoin (destination address required). Set preview to price without committing.

destinationAddress.description: Destination wallet address. Required for on-ramp

destinationCountry.description: Destination country, ISO 2-letter. Required for off-ramp

destinationCurrency.description: Destination currency: fiat for off-ramp (e.g. 'EUR'), a stablecoin for on-ramp

destinationNetwork.description: Off-ramp: payment network, 'swift' or 'bank'. On-ramp: blockchain network. Replaces the old paymentMethodType

preview.description: Price the quote without persisting it, to show an estimate

sourceAmount.description: Amount to convert, in major units (e.g. '125.75')

sourceCurrency.description: Source currency: a stablecoin for off-ramp (e.g. 'USDT'), fiat for on-ramp

sourceNetwork.description: Blockchain network of the source. Required for off-ramp, omitted for on-ramp

name: create_quote
title: Create quote
